entries.38badc42a637b871: This is the Group's core business, carried out by the company and its consolidated subsidiaries. It develops the new-build whole-building investment rental housing brands "EL FARO," "MIJAS" and "LOS ARCOS," concentrating on the Jonan and Josai areas, which are popular even within Tokyo's 23 wards. Sales to external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 were ¥30,583 million, accounting for about 8 tenths of the Group's total sales. During the period, it delivered 39 buildings in the series, as well as 1 used income-producing property and 2 development sites.
